summary: Lumpinee is Bangkok’s modern Muay Thai arena in Ram Inthra, well north-east of the historic centre. It is most practical when a scheduled fight fits your dates; ONE Friday Fights are a regular draw, with other Saturday cards also listed.
whyGo: See professional Muay Thai in a major Bangkok arena, with a live crowd and several bouts in one event.
The current ONE calendar lists Lumpinee events on Fridays in December 2026, including Dec 4, 11 and 18, plus ONE Fight Night 50 on Dec 19; check the live calendar before committing.
bestFor: Travellers who enjoy live combat sport and can plan an evening or morning around a published fight card.
Visitors who want a contemporary arena atmosphere and are comfortable with loud sound and physical violence.
skipIf: You want a calm cultural performance, dislike violence or loud crowds, or have limited time and are staying around the old town.
duration: Allow about 3–4 hours door to door from central Bangkok, including the trip to Ram Inthra and an event with multiple bouts; this is a planning estimate, not a published event duration.
cost: The venue’s currently posted examples are Friday ONE grandstand tickets at THB 1,000 or fixed-chair Cat 2 at THB 2,750, and Saturday seats from THB 1,000 to THB 2,000. Treat these as indicative: event, seat category and price may change, and verify the exact December listing before purchase.
hours: No general visitor hours: attend a ticketed event. The venue currently posts Friday ONE show time as 7:00 pm and Saturday show time as 5:30 pm; the ONE calendar lists its Friday cards at 11:30 UTC (6:30 pm Bangkok time), so use the time on the selected event ticket.
bestTime: Choose a date with a confirmed card. Friday evening ONE events are the most predictable pattern; December 2026 dates are already shown on ONE’s event calendar, but event details remain subject to change.
gettingThere: Address: 6 Ram Inthra Road, Anusawari, Bang Khen. The MRT Pink Line’s Ram Inthra 3 station is the nearest rail stop (roughly 800 m by map); walk from there or use a taxi/ride-hail for the last stretch. Expect slower road travel around Friday evening peak traffic and allow extra time for the return trip.
booking: Use the event’s ticket link from ONE Championship or the venue’s official ticket page/ThaiTicketMajor listing. Select a specific event and seat category; do not rely on a generic weekly schedule. Save the e-ticket and recheck the event time and venue instructions shortly before going.
accessibility: The sources reviewed do not confirm step-free routes, wheelchair seating, accessible toilets or assistance arrangements. Contact the stadium or ticket seller about the specific event and seat before booking if these matter.
practicalTips: Compare seat categories on the event listing; the current venue page shows a substantial price difference between Friday grandstand and fixed-chair seats.
Arrive before the printed start time to find your entrance and seat; event times differ between listings.
Plan the return journey in advance: the venue is outside the central tourist area, and road traffic can be slow on Friday evenings.
decemberNotes: As checked on 17 October 2026, ONE’s official calendar lists Lumpinee cards on Dec 4, 11 and 18 and ONE Fight Night 50 on Dec 19. These are event-calendar listings, not a guarantee that the card, time, availability or price will remain unchanged. December evenings are often more comfortable outdoors than the hot season, but the arena is indoors; this is a planning inference rather than venue guidance.
uncertainties: December event details and seat availability may change; recheck the official event and ticket pages close to travel.
The venue and ONE pages currently show slightly different Friday start times (7:00 pm and 6:30 pm); follow the event-specific ticket time.
No reliable accessibility details or fixed event duration were found in the reviewed sources.
Image reuse permission was not established; the linked photo is a reference image of the stadium exterior.
